/category/commercial/.title: Commercial Renovation Guides
/category/commercial/.description: Planning guides for retail and office renovation, including layout, services, access and handover considerations.
/category/commercial/.introduction: Browse practical guidance for commercial premises in Kuala Lumpur and Petaling Jaya. These articles cover retail planning and office fit-out coordination before a site-based scope is confirmed.

/category/hvac-guides/.title: Aircond Installation and Maintenance Guides
/category/hvac-guides/.description: Aircond guides covering installation planning, maintenance and quotation factors for Kuala Lumpur and Selangor properties.
/category/hvac-guides/.introduction: Use these guides to compare installation requirements, prepare a site brief and recognise when an aircond problem needs inspection rather than assumptions.

/category/maintenance/.title: Property Maintenance Guides
/category/maintenance/.description: Maintenance planning for aircond servicing, cleaning, leakage inspection and site-dependent repair work.
/category/maintenance/.introduction: These guides help property owners describe maintenance symptoms and prepare for inspection across aircond, cleaning and waterproofing work. The suitable scope still depends on the property condition.

/category/renovation/.title: Renovation Planning Guides
/category/renovation/.description: Residential and retail renovation guides covering scope, materials, coordination, sequencing, quotation and handover.
/category/renovation/.introduction: Start a renovation discussion with a clearer brief. This collection covers house and retail projects while keeping final cost, timing and approval questions tied to the actual premises.

/category/servis-pembersihan/.title: Panduan Servis Pembersihan Rumah
/category/servis-pembersihan/.description: Panduan merancang servis cuci rumah dan deep cleaning di Kuala Lumpur berdasarkan keadaan dan skop sebenar.
/category/servis-pembersihan/.introduction: Rujuk panduan ini untuk menyediakan senarai ruang, keadaan rumah dan jenis cucian sebelum meminta sebut harga. Ketersediaan dan skop akhir perlu disahkan semasa pertanyaan.

/category/technical-guides/.title: Technical Property Guides
/category/technical-guides/.description: Safety, inspection and technical planning guides for electrical, aircond, waterproofing and ceiling work.
/category/technical-guides/.introduction: Review the technical questions that should be settled before work begins, from electrical warning signs and aircond routes to leak sources and ceiling coordination. These guides do not replace a site inspection.

/tag/interior-finishing/.title: Interior Finishing Guides
/tag/interior-finishing/.description: Practical guides for plaster ceilings and coordinated finishing work in renovation projects.
/tag/interior-finishing/.introduction: Interior finishes work best when ceilings, lighting, services, surfaces and access are coordinated early. These guides focus on that planning rather than unsupported design promises.

/tag/office-fit-out/.title: Office Fit-Out Guides
/tag/office-fit-out/.description: Office renovation planning for Kuala Lumpur and Petaling Jaya premises, including layout, services and building requirements.
/tag/office-fit-out/.introduction: Compare two location-focused office fit-out guides covering layouts, service coordination, premises rules and the agreed handover condition.

/tag/waterproofing/.title: Waterproofing and Leak Guides
/tag/waterproofing/.description: Leak inspection and PU injection guidance for site-dependent waterproofing decisions in Kuala Lumpur.
/tag/waterproofing/.introduction: Learn how visible dampness, cracks and water paths are assessed before a repair method is selected. Both guides emphasise inspection and avoid promising a universal permanent result.
